pages.text: $(bold)Embedded Shadow Court$(): within the shadow court, ten thousand beasts arise.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x60 curse power per second. Every target inside except the caster is $(red)forcibly frozen$() - unable to move or fight back; $(bold)the three New Shadow Style techniques can resist this domain's freeze$() (as with Taizang Field - only Execution cannot be resisted).

$(bold)Beasts of the Shadow Court$(): the moment it expands, the domain summons $(bold)the entire Ten Shadows roster, doubled$() - all ten shikigami types (Divine Dogs x4, Rabbit Escape x16, and two of each of the rest, forty-odd in all), every one already tamed and scaled in strength by the caster's curse affinity/output, hunting and swarming the frozen targets within the domain.$(br2)$(bold)Closing$(): when the domain closes (manually, out of curse power, or destroyed), all of its shikigami vanish immediately; if the caster dies, they likewise disperse through the usual shikigami cleanup logic.
